title: Internal canonical completeness from its quotient Roos triangle
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme X. Use the unbounded internal module derived category and positive reductions of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. Let K be any object, suppose its integralLevel tower has a product, and suppose the product of the specified derived tensor units K -> integralLevel_n K is the first arrow of a distinguished Roos triangle for the specified integralStep transitions [def-weil-derived-limit]. Then the canonical augmentation on a K-flat representative is invertible, i.e. K satisfies IsDerivedComplete of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. No boundedness, constructibility or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat representative P of K, and the recorded distinguished Roos triangle on Q(roos P). Rotate this triangle and the assumed triangle. Their first two vertices and their first arrow are identical. The distinguished-triangle isomorphism theorem gives an isomorphism of their third vertices; reflect it through the shift equivalence to obtain K isomorphic to Q(roos P). The latter is complete by output completeness. In the existential definition of IsDerivedComplete compose its representative isomorphism with this isomorphism, retaining the same K-flat complex and invertible actual augmentation. No equality between an arbitrary triangle isomorphism and the specified augmentation is claimed.

proof_origin.place: Rotate the two actual reduction Roos triangles, identify their first vertices by the shift equivalence, then transfer output completeness.

theorem isDerivedComplete_of_roos
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules l E X)) [HasProduct (integralLevel l E X K)]
    (δ : (∏ᶜ (integralLevel l E X K)) ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hδ : IsDerivedLimitTriangle (integralStep l E X K) K
      (Pi.lift (fun n ↦ (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction
        (quotient l E X n)).unit.app K)) δ) :
    IsDerivedComplete l E X K
